about_the_game:
The protagonist has long neglected a villa inherited from their late father.

When they finally begin cleaning it to prepare for sale through a real estate agent,
they discover a hidden code beneath the kitchen grime.

As the cleaning continues, more cryptic clues are uncovered.
While unraveling the mysteries surrounding the villa and their father,
the protagonist finds themselves drawn deeper into something unexpected...

Key Features

1. Real Cleaning Products Appear In-Game

Authentic cleaning items such as Kao’s Magiclean and Quickle Wiper are featured as usable items.
Players can take advantage of each product’s real-world cleaning strengths—
and there may even be hidden tricks that involve combining items for enhanced cleaning effects.

2. Find Hidden Codes and Mechanisms in Each Stage

The villa is divided into multiple stages, each containing hidden codes and environmental puzzles.
Use your cleaning tools wisely to uncover these secrets and find the keys to progress.

3. Something Creeps Closer as You Clean...

An ominous presence roams the villa, responding to subtle sounds like footsteps and scrubbing.
Stay alert while cleaning—every sound could put you at risk.
Avoid detection, uncover the secrets, and escape the villa alive.

Featured Cleaning Items

  • Magiclean Handy Spray (Kitchen)

  • Magiclean Foaming Toilet Cleaner (No Scrub Required)

  • Magiclean Air Jet Sanitizer for Bathrooms

  • Quickle Wiper 3D Wet Sheets – STRONG Odor Elimination

  • Magiclean EXPOWER Spray for Hard Water Stains

Estimated Play Time

30–90 minutes

short_description: “Stay hidden. Clean up.” A 3D exploratory horror-action and cleaning simulation game using household cleaning products. Clean the house and solve mysteries to escape. An unconventional horror experience where the appraised value of the house changes based on your cleaning rate and escape time.
